history_perturbations.measurement_count_definition: measured_users counts finite original prefixes; each comparison has its own count of finite paired measurements

limitations: Training-pair and training-prefix diagnostics are not held-out validation metrics.
Perturbation users are separate from the native five-users-per-category panel.
This invocation covers only the supplied view; it does not imply four-category coverage.
Targets are the final public training events; the model may have trained on them.
Targets, candidates, and truncated visible prefixes are frozen within each comparison; no backfilling occurs.
All primary two-event deletions retain the final interaction. Final-interaction deletion is separate.
Compact deletion uses ordinary model positions; preserved-position comparisons require an explicit encoder hook.
Padding replacement changes the padding pattern and recent-event membership; its effect on attention depends on the encoder's actual masking implementation.

Replacement items exclude both the public history and diagnostic candidates; the same two replacements are used for recent and older windows. Comparisons are unavailable when fewer than two replacements exist.
Four-event random-control bands contain their corresponding primary windows but overlap each other; they are broad recency controls, not exact-distance matches.
Diagnostic RNG and module training modes are restored. Loader iterator cursors and worker-local RNG states cannot be restored; use a separate diagnostic loader when resuming training.

This diagnostic patch does not implement the proposed readout, encoder position-ID hook, checkpoint architecture, predictor reconstruction, or host selection policy. Those require separate training-code changes.
Position-hook support does not prove that an implementation honors supplied position IDs.
Perturbations may be out of distribution and establish neither generalization nor causal preferences.
Bootstrap intervals resample diagnostic users and condition on this model, sample, and candidates.
No reviews, ratings, item categories, prices, stores, or simulator traits are measured.
Unavailable comparisons return null measurements with count zero; they were not executed.

metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Legacy key: (mean off-diagonal item-embedding cosine + 1)/2, excluding padding. Measures directional alignment only; it does not by itself establish collapse or recommendation diversity.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample_count: Number of finite, nonzero sampled embeddings used in alignment; zero when fewer than two can be measured.
metric_definitions.embedding_excluded_count: Sampled embeddings excluded for nonfinite coordinates or zero norm.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit on finite, nonpadding training pairs using the actual trained feature and scoring path.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile of finite training-pair margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of measured training pairs with margin below zero.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of measured training pairs with margin below 0.5.
metric_definitions.training_pair_count: Number of finite training pairs used in margin summaries; zero means summaries are undefined.
metric_definitions.training_batch_count: Number of structurally valid loader batches scored, up to ten.
metric_definitions.training_pair_nonfinite_count: Eligible nonpadding training pairs excluded because logits or margins were nonfinite.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Position counts at eps=0.5; category lists remain empty because categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.sequence_feature_geometry: First up to 2048 finite valid blended training states: sample count, mean L2 norm, and centered effective rank exp(-sum(p log p)), with p proportional to numerically nonzero singular values. Rank is null for insufficient or constant samples. This position sample is not a user-level uncertainty estimate.
metric_definitions.learned_scalar_gates: Measured scalar sigmoid(gate_logit) or tanh(alpha), with module names and the actual transform. An empty list means no supported scalar gate was observed; conditional gates are not reduced to a fictitious scalar.
metric_definitions.history_perturbations: Local seed-42 sample of up to twenty users from the current view with at least ten prefix events and a public training next-item target. Candidates contain that target and up to 99 unique negatives excluding the entire public training history. Shortages and coverage are reported. For a prefix of n events, recent deletion removes indices n-3,n-2 and immediately older deletion removes n-5,n-4. Random controls remove two events globally, within indices n-5..n-2, or within n-7..n-4. Each four-event band contains its corresponding primary deletion window; the bands overlap. Content replacement uses two distinct unseen items excluded from all diagnostic candidates, at fixed positions and length. Identical replacements are used for recent and older windows; shortages are reported and those comparisons are skipped. Preserved-position deletion assigns survivors their original absolute positions. Position shifts subtract one with content unchanged only when indices remain valid. Readout always uses the largest surviving valid sequence index, including the separate final-event deletion. Outcomes are observed-target score, target-minus-mean-negative score, one-based target rank, diagnostic HR@10, and top-ten candidate overlap with the original model. Stable candidate ordering resolves ties with the target first. Changes equal perturbed minus original; higher rank changes mean worse ranks. Each comparison reports paired means, measurement count, and percentile intervals from 2000 seed-42 user bootstrap replicates. Strata use untruncated prefix length at most twenty versus longer, and target training frequency at most versus above the median frequency among observed training items. These candidates and HR values never replace the pinned host evaluator.
metric_definitions.limitations: Explicit missingness, scope, positional controls, and limits on interpretation of fitted-model diagnostics.
